test_cases.test_name: Verify Continuous Temperature Monitoring and Recording Intervals
test_cases.objective: To verify that the Environmental Monitoring System continuously monitors temperature in GMP storage areas and records readings at intervals not exceeding 5 minutes.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are installed and calibrated in all GMP storage areas.
System is powered on and operational.

test_steps.action: Observe the EMS interface for a designated GMP storage area.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS displays real-time temperature readings for the storage area.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of EMS interface showing real-time temperature.

test_steps.action: Monitor the EMS data log or database for the same storage area over a period of at least 10 minutes.
test_steps.expected_result: Temperature readings are recorded in the data log/database at intervals of 5 minutes or less.
data_to_capture: Exported data log or database records showing timestamped temperature readings.
Calculated time difference between consecutive readings.

acceptance_criteria: The EMS continuously displays real-time temperature readings.
All recorded temperature readings are within the specified 5-minute interval.
No gaps in data recording are observed during the monitoring period.
data_integrity_requirements: Data is captured accurately and without alteration.
Timestamps are accurate and reflect actual recording times.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Temperature Alarm Generation and Notification
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS generates alerts when temperature deviates ±2°C from the setpoint and that the system response time for alarm conditions does not exceed 30 seconds.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are installed and calibrated in all GMP storage areas.
A specific GMP storage area with a defined temperature setpoint is selected for testing.
Alarm setpoints are configured in the EMS.
Site paging system is operational and configured for integration.

test_steps.action: Manually adjust the temperature in the selected GMP storage area to be 2°C above or below the defined setpoint.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an audible and/or visual alarm notification.

test_steps.action: Record the time from the temperature deviation to the first indication of an alarm on the EMS.
test_steps.expected_result: The time elapsed between temperature deviation and alarm indication is less than or equal to 30 seconds.

test_steps.action: Verify that the alarm notification is sent to the site paging system.
test_steps.expected_result: An alarm notification is received on the designated paging system.
data_to_capture: Confirmation of receipt by relevant personnel.

test_steps.action: Return the temperature in the storage area to within the normal operating range.
test_steps.expected_result: The alarm condition is cleared in the EMS and on the paging system.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of EMS showing alarm cleared.
Confirmation of alarm clearing on paging system.

acceptance_criteria: An alarm is generated when temperature deviates ±2°C from the setpoint.
Alarm response time does not exceed 30 seconds.
Alarm notifications are successfully sent to the site paging system.
Alarm conditions are cleared upon return to normal operating temperature.
data_integrity_requirements: Accurate recording of alarm trigger times and alarm clearing times.
Verification of successful transmission of alarm notifications.

test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS accurately measures and records temperature within the specified range.
prerequisites: EMS is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are calibrated.
Access to EMS software and reporting tools.

test_steps.action: Introduce a calibrated temperature source to a sensor within the EMS monitoring range, starting at -80°C.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS displays and records the temperature reading within ±0.5°C of the calibrated source.

test_steps.action: Gradually increase the temperature source to +50°C, ensuring readings are taken at multiple points within the range (e.g., -40°C, 0°C, +20°C, +40°C).
test_steps.expected_result: At each temperature point, the EMS displays and records the temperature reading within ±0.5°C of the calibrated source.
data_to_capture: Calibrated temperature source readings at various points
EMS recorded temperature readings at various points

acceptance_criteria: All recorded temperature readings are within ±0.5°C of the calibrated temperature source across the entire -80°C to +50°C range.
data_integrity_requirements: Data shall be accurate and complete.
Data shall be attributable to the sensor and time of measurement.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Audit Trail and Electronic Signature Functionality
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system generates and maintains a compliant audit trail and supports electronic signatures as per 21 CFR Part 11.
prerequisites: EMS is installed and configured.
User accounts with appropriate permissions are created.
Access to EMS audit trail viewer and electronic signature functionality.

test_steps.action: Perform a system configuration change (e.g., adjust a setpoint or alarm threshold) using a user account.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS audit trail records the change, including the user who made the change, the date and time, and the nature of the change.
data_to_capture: Audit trail entry for configuration change

test_steps.action: Initiate an action requiring an electronic signature (e.g., acknowledge an alarm, approve a report).
test_steps.expected_result: The system prompts for electronic signature credentials, and upon successful entry, records the signature, user ID, date, and time in the audit trail.
data_to_capture: Audit trail entry for action requiring electronic signature

test_steps.action: Review the audit trail for a period of 7 years to ensure data retention and integrity.
test_steps.expected_result: All relevant events are logged in the audit trail and are accessible for the specified retention period.
data_to_capture: Sample audit trail entries from different time periods
Confirmation of data accessibility for 7 years

acceptance_criteria: The audit trail accurately and completely records all significant events, including user actions, date, time, and the event details.
Electronic signatures are captured with user authentication, date, and time.
Audit trail data is retained for the specified 7-year period and remains accessible.
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail shall be secure, unalterable, and time-stamped.
Electronic signatures shall be legally equivalent to handwritten signatures.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Data Storage and Archival Functionality
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system can store data for at least 10 years and utilize the vendor's archival feature.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Sufficient storage space is allocated for 10 years of data.
Archival feature is enabled and configured.

test_steps.action: Simulate continuous temperature monitoring for a period equivalent to 10 years of data generation (e.g., by adjusting system clock or using data simulation tools).
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully records and stores temperature data without errors.
data_to_capture: System logs for data storage errors.

test_steps.action: Initiate the vendor's archival process for the generated historical data.
test_steps.expected_result: The archival process completes successfully, and archived data is accessible.

test_steps.action: Verify that the system's active data storage capacity is not exceeded after archival.
test_steps.expected_result: The system continues to operate normally and store new data.

acceptance_criteria: The EMS system successfully stores simulated data for a period equivalent to 10 years.
The vendor's archival feature successfully archives the historical data.
Archived data is retrievable and intact.
System performance is not negatively impacted by data storage and archival.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-010: Data shall be retained for 7 years using vendor's archival feature.
URS-EMS-012: Data storage capacity shall support minimum 10 years of continuous monitoring.
data_integrity_requirements: Data shall be stored accurately and completely for the required retention period.
Archival process shall not corrupt or delete original data.
Archived data shall be retrievable in its original format.

test_cases.test_name: Verify System Availability and Integration with Paging System
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system meets the required availability percentage and successfully integrates with the site paging system for alarm notifications.
prerequisites: EMS system is operational.
Site paging system is operational and accessible.
Vendor API for alarm notifications is configured and available.

test_steps.action: Monitor system uptime over a defined period (e.g., 7 days) excluding planned maintenance windows.
test_steps.expected_result: The system is available for at least 99.5% of the monitored time.
data_to_capture: Dates and durations of planned maintenance.

test_steps.action: Induce a temperature alarm condition that triggers an alert.
test_steps.expected_result: An alarm notification is sent to the site paging system within the specified response time.

test_steps.action: Verify that the alarm notification received by the paging system is accurate and contains all relevant information (e.g., location, temperature value, setpoint).
test_steps.expected_result: The notification is clear, accurate, and actionable.
data_to_capture: Screenshot or log of the received paging notification.

acceptance_criteria: System availability is 99.5% or higher, excluding planned maintenance.
Alarm notifications are successfully transmitted to the site paging system.
Alarm notifications are received within the specified response time (URS-EMS-011).
Alarm notification content is accurate and complete.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-011: System response time shall not exceed 30 seconds for alarm conditions.
URS-EMS-013: System availability shall be 99.5% excluding planned maintenance.
URS-EMS-015: Alarm notifications shall integrate with site paging system using vendor API.
data_integrity_requirements: Alarm notifications must be timely and accurate to ensure product integrity.
System availability is critical for continuous monitoring and timely intervention.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Vendor-Supplied Software Usage and Standard Report Generation
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system utilizes vendor-supplied software without modification and that standard reports are used for batch release.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and configured.
Access to EMS administration and reporting modules.
Documentation confirming vendor-supplied software version.

test_steps.action: Access the EMS system's software information or configuration settings.
test_steps.expected_result: The system displays information indicating it is using vendor-supplied software without any custom modifications.

test_steps.action: Generate a standard report for a specific period (e.g., a day or week) using the vendor's built-in reporting functionality.
test_steps.expected_result: A standard report is generated successfully, containing relevant temperature and humidity data.

test_steps.action: Review the generated standard report to confirm it aligns with the expected format and content for batch release purposes.
test_steps.expected_result: The generated report is in the vendor's standard format and contains all necessary data points for batch release review.
data_to_capture: Confirmation of report format and content suitability for batch release

acceptance_criteria: The system confirms the use of vendor-supplied software without modification.
Standard reports can be generated successfully using the vendor's built-in functionality.
Generated standard reports are suitable for batch release.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-003: The system shall use vendor-supplied software without modification.
URS-EMS-007: Standard reports provided by vendor shall be used for batch release.
data_integrity_requirements: Ensure no unauthorized modifications to vendor software.
Verify report data accuracy and completeness.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Data Storage Capacity and System Availability
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system's data storage capacity meets the minimum 10-year requirement and that system availability is within the specified 99.5% target.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and operational.
Access to system logs and performance monitoring tools.
Knowledge of planned maintenance schedule.

test_steps.action: Determine the current data storage utilization and estimate the rate of data accumulation based on monitoring intervals.
test_steps.expected_result: The system's current storage utilization is recorded, and the data accumulation rate is calculated.

test_steps.action: Calculate the projected storage required for 10 years of continuous monitoring based on the current accumulation rate.
test_steps.expected_result: The calculated projected storage requirement for 10 years is less than or equal to the available storage capacity.

test_steps.action: Monitor system uptime over a defined period (e.g., 1 month) and record any unplanned downtime.
test_steps.expected_result: The total uptime percentage, excluding planned maintenance, is calculated and is at least 99.5%.

acceptance_criteria: The projected data storage requirement for 10 years is within the system's capacity.
The system's availability, excluding planned maintenance, is 99.5% or higher over the test period.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-012: Data storage capacity shall support minimum 10 years of continuous monitoring.
URS-EMS-013: System availability shall be 99.5% excluding planned maintenance.
data_integrity_requirements: Ensure sufficient storage to prevent data loss.
Verify system reliability and continuous operation.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Temperature Range and Accuracy with Setpoint Deviation
test_cases.objective: To verify the system's ability to accurately monitor temperature within the specified range and generate alerts when deviating from setpoints.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are calibrated and operational.
System is connected to power and network.

test_steps.action: Introduce a controlled temperature change in a GMP storage area to simulate a deviation of +1.5°C from a setpoint of 20°C.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS records the temperature accurately within ±0.5°C of the actual temperature. No alarm is generated.
data_to_capture: Actual temperature readings from calibrated reference thermometer

test_steps.action: Introduce a controlled temperature change in a GMP storage area to simulate a deviation of +2.5°C from a setpoint of 20°C.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS records the temperature accurately within ±0.5°C of the actual temperature. An alarm is generated and logged by the system.
data_to_capture: Actual temperature readings from calibrated reference thermometer

test_steps.action: Introduce a controlled temperature change in a GMP storage area to simulate a deviation of -1.5°C from a setpoint of 20°C.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS records the temperature accurately within ±0.5°C of the actual temperature. No alarm is generated.
data_to_capture: Actual temperature readings from calibrated reference thermometer

test_steps.action: Introduce a controlled temperature change in a GMP storage area to simulate a deviation of -2.5°C from a setpoint of 20°C.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS records the temperature accurately within ±0.5°C of the actual temperature. An alarm is generated and logged by the system.
data_to_capture: Actual temperature readings from calibrated reference thermometer

acceptance_criteria: All recorded temperatures are within ±0.5°C of the actual temperature.
Alarms are generated precisely when temperature deviates ±2°C from the setpoint.
Alarm events are correctly logged in the system's audit trail.
data_integrity_requirements: Data accuracy
Timeliness of data recording
Completeness of alarm logging

test_cases.test_name: Verify Data Storage Capacity and Archival Functionality
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system can store data for at least 10 years and that the archival feature functions correctly.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and configured.
System has sufficient disk space for initial data storage.
Archival mechanism (e.g., network storage, tape drive) is accessible and configured.

test_steps.action: Simulate continuous temperature and humidity monitoring for a period equivalent to 10 years of data generation, based on the defined recording intervals (URS-EMS-002). This may involve data generation scripts or accelerated data input.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS successfully stores all generated data in the vendor's standard database format without errors or data loss.
data_to_capture: System logs indicating no storage errors
Disk space utilization before and after simulation

test_steps.action: Initiate the vendor's archival feature to move data older than a specified retention period (e.g., 7 years) to the archival storage.
test_steps.expected_result: The archival process completes successfully, and the specified data is moved from the primary database to the archival location. The primary database should reflect the removal of archived data.
data_to_capture: System logs detailing the archival operation
Verification of data presence in archival storage
Verification of data absence/reduction in primary storage

test_steps.action: Attempt to retrieve a sample of archived data using the vendor's standard retrieval mechanism.
test_steps.expected_result: The archived data is successfully retrieved and is identical to the original data.
data_to_capture: Comparison of retrieved data with original data

acceptance_criteria: The system demonstrates the capacity to store a minimum of 10 years of continuous monitoring data.
The archival process successfully moves data to the designated archival location.
Archived data can be retrieved and verified for integrity.
No data loss or corruption occurs during storage or archival.
data_integrity_requirements: Data retention
Data archival
Data retrieval
Data completeness
Data accuracy
